utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good morning to everybody in and around the courtroom. Mr. Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-81-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Could we have appearances for the day starting with the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning, counsel, everyone in the courtroom. Mark Harmon, Salvatore Cannata and Carmela Javier for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone participating in the trial. Deirdre Montgomery, Tina Drolec, Milos Androvic, Daniela Tasic, Mr. Gregor Guy-Smith, and Novak Lukic represent Mr. Perisic today in this courtroom.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Good morning, sir.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: To warn you, and I know you already know it, that you are still bound by the declaration you made at the beginning of your testimony to tell the truth, the whole truth and nothing else but the truth. Mr. Lukic, how much longer are you likely to be? Yesterday you equalled your opposite number in hours.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I believe I'm going to finish during this session for sure, the first session today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you. Sorry, just before you start, Mr. Lukic. I'm sorry, it's my fault. May the Chamber please move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are back in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. The matter is postponed to tomorrow, 9.00 in the morning. Courtroom I. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 26th day of August, 2009, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 10.50 a.m.,
